prompt: The attached image is the chosen draft. Keep its design, pose, composition and colors, and redraw it as the clean finished version: crisp uniform outline, tidy flat shapes, no stray marks. Special premium portrait: inside a LIGHT circular medallion with a clean white-ivory background (#fffaf0) and an antique-gold rim (#e2b04a), the character slightly overlapping the rim at the bottom.
